# Vendored packages

`Citadel` is orlandos-nl/Citadel 0.12.1 (commit ae8562f895de06ccb86fdb1cbb65fd99c8976e12, MIT) and `swift-nio-ssh` is the Wellz26/swift-nio-ssh fork at 0.3.7 (commit d88989f3d3bb1dfb2a38ce4af598afbf7fc3095c, Apache-2.0), the revision Citadel 0.12.1 resolves to. Both are vendored because neither upstream supports keyboard-interactive authentication (RFC 4256), which hosts with two-factor login require, and because Togo needs the connection's root channel, which Citadel keeps internal. The first commit that adds this directory holds the sources unmodified; later commits add keyboard-interactive to swift-nio-ssh (client and server), point Citadel's manifest at `../swift-nio-ssh`, drop Citadel's example server target and its ColorizeSwift dependency, make Citadel's login timeout configurable, forward keyboard-interactive prompts to custom auth delegates, and add `SSHClient.channel`. Each package keeps its own LICENSE file; neither apple/swift-nio-ssh nor the fork ships a NOTICE file. Every modified source file starts with a line stating the change.
